name: mark_tie_credits_the_eye_that_holds
description: Two Lookouts' Owl's Eyes mark one Thornback at the same strength (+20% each). While both refresh it, the lower-id eye (seat 2's, which marked it first) keeps the credit. Once seat 2 sells its eye, the mark that still applies is seat 3's alone, so from the next tick it is seat 3's: Help on the Lamplighter's hits goes to seat 3, and seat 2, with no tower marking anything, earns none (design 3.2).

steps.assert: t[1].owner == 2 and t[2].owner == 3 and t[1].id < t[2].id
steps.msg: seat 2's eye has the lower id

steps.assert: scene.creep(c).mark_seat == 2 and t[1].marked == PackedInt32Array([c]) and t[2].marked == PackedInt32Array([c])
steps.msg: both eyes hold the Thornback; seat 2's mark took hold first
the Thornback is still marked +20%, by seat 3's eye alone
four seconds after the sale the mark that applies is seat 3's
seat 2, with no eye, earns no Help four seconds later
seat 3, whose eye marks it, earns the Help
